query: SELECT mr.id, mr.medicationName, mr.dosage, mr.frequency, mr.reminderTime, mg.name as groupName FROM medication_reminders mr LEFT JOIN medication_groups mg ON mr.groupId = mg.id WHERE mr.userId = 4 AND mr.isActive = 1 ORDER BY mg.name, mr.medicationName;
